target: sign of TWII same-day close versus prior completed cash close
decision_time: after completed TX night session and before TWII cash open
hypothesis: A pathological completed 15-minute TX night path identifies when the night-spread direction will fail to transmit to the same-day cash close.

ablation.control: previous causal reliability, cash-volatility and overseas regime on the microstructure-aligned dates
ablation.treatment: same control plus 13 fixed completed-session path features

amendment_policy: Any later code, feature, hyperparameter or gate change creates a new experiment id and cannot alter v1 conclusions.
